name: Founder Control Room executable local core
acceptanceCriteria: The authenticated loopback server binds only to 127.0.0.1, accepts only fixed allowlisted missions, and never converts free-form browser input into a shell command.
Mission timeout terminates the complete process tree and retains the one-mission lock until descendants are no longer alive.
Frontend verification retains timestamped Playwright evidence while non-browser fallback remains explicitly labeled and cannot satisfy browser proof.
